description: This file defines controller functions for handling transfer-related API endpoints in a Node.js application, including retrieving all transfers for a user, retrieving a single transfer, and creating a new transfer.

methods.name: getMyTransfers
methods.description: Retrieves all transfer records associated with the authenticated user, either as sender or recipient.

methods.name: getSingle
methods.description: Retrieves a specific transfer record by ID, ensuring the user is either sender or recipient.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new transfer record based on the request body and saves it to the database.
